start_here: Say to your AI: "Search every list, record and file name I keep with one question, in one ranked list, without my own computer", with {"question":"merlinfalcon", "records": [...], "files": {...}} (the records and files read from your own store). It runs tool:search-everything-in-a-small-container and answers one ranked list of hits, each with found_in, said, score and address.
no_lists_because: It names no list of yours: it takes its input and the rows and file names of yours it is given, and keeps nothing.
instructions: 1. Say to your AI: "Search every list, record and file name I keep with one question, in one ranked list, without my own computer", and give it question (The person's question or the words to find).
2. The AI calls do_one_thing_in_my_account at @tools with method tools:run, tool tool:search-everything-in-a-small-container and its input (the worked example shows one).

3. Read what comes back: Searches everything this person keeps with one question, as a Workshop run: every kind of record (each kind ranked as its own lane) and their files by name, merged by reciprocal rank into one list, best first.
4. It is given only rows of every kind and the names of the person's files (reads).
